test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: According to the Union Budget 2022-23, which among the following is NOT one of the seven engines of economic growth under "PM Gati Shakti"?
solution:
The correct is** __Communication.__****__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• In **Union Budget 2022-23,** **Communication** is not one of the **seven engines of economic growth under "PM Gati Shakti".** 
 
• **Finance Minister Nirmala Sitaraman** said on 1 February that **PM Gati Shakti National Mater Plan is a Transformative approach for economic growth and sustainable development **by and driven by **seven engines, Roads, Railways, airports, ports, mass, transport, waterways, and logistics, infrastructure.**
 
• **PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan (PMGS-NMP) was launched on 13th October 2021** for providing multimodal connectivity infrastructure to various economic zones.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• To prioritize its projects under the **PM Gati Shakti Scheme**, the** Ministry of Railways has set up a new directorate under the Railway Board.**
 
• **The Road Transportation and Indian Highways Ministry **had made notable progress under the PM Modi government’s “PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan”, which was **aimed at improving the multi-modal connectivity and Connectivity of India also.**
 
• **The Union Minister for Ports, Shipping, and, Waterways, Sarbananda Sonowal** said that the PM Gati Shakti mission will lead to the** removal of all bottlenecks in infrastructure development along with achieving timely completion of projects.**
